eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED MONTHLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Hawaii; at 2:14 PM on AUG 2, 2016 Effective until 2:44 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is a coordinated test of the Emergency Alert System for broadcast stations in Hawaii. As a reminder, the regular monthly test of the Emergency Alert System and Outdoor Siren Warning System will be conducted at 11:45 a.m. This concludes the test of the Emergency Alert System. none
